questions.def: We use 'what' to ask about a thing in an indirect question.
questions.question: I asked him ___ he wanted to eat.

questions.def: 'Where' is used to ask about a place in an indirect question.
questions.question: I wonder ___ she is going.

questions.def: We use 'if' to introduce an indirect question about possibility.
questions.question: I don't ___ if he likes it.

questions.def: 'What' is used to ask about the time in an indirect question.
questions.question: Can you tell me ___ time it is?

questions.def: 'If' introduces an indirect question that expresses doubt.
questions.question: I'm not sure ___ he will come.

questions.def: 'If' is used to ask about a state of being (happiness).
questions.question: I asked her ___ she was happy.

questions.def: 'How' is used to ask about the amount or price.
questions.question: I need to know ___ much it costs.

questions.def: 'What' is used to ask about actions in an indirect question.
questions.question: I asked him ___ he was going to do.

questions.def: 'Where' is used to ask about location in indirect questions.
questions.question: I wonder ___ she went.

questions.def: 'If' is used to ask whether someone likes something.
questions.question: Tell me ___ you like this movie.

questions.def: 'When' is used to ask about the time of arrival.
questions.question: I don't know ___ he will arrive.

questions.def: 'How' is used to ask about the method of doing something.
questions.question: I wonder ___ he does it.

questions.def: 'How' is used to ask about age.
questions.question: She wants to know ___ old I am.

questions.def: 'Whose' is used to ask about possession.
questions.question: Do you know ___ car this is?

questions.def: 'If' introduces an indirect question about the truth of something.
questions.question: I'm not sure ___ it is true.

questions.def: 'Where' is used to ask about someone's place of residence.
questions.question: I'd like to know ___ you live.

questions.def: 'Who' is used to ask about a person's identity.
questions.question: I need to ask ___ he is.

questions.def: 'If' is used to ask about preferences in an indirect way.
questions.question: I wonder ___ she likes cats.

questions.def: 'How' is used to ask about the method of making something.
questions.question: Tell me ___ you made this cake.

questions.def: 'Which' is used to offer a choice between two options.
questions.question: I don't know ___ way to go.

questions.def: 'If' is used to introduce an indirect question to know his wishes.
questions.question: I asked him ___ he wanted anything.

questions.def: 'Whether' can be used instead of 'if' in indirect questions.
questions.question: I'm not sure ___ they will come.

questions.def: 'If' introduce indirect question to know about state of being.
questions.question: She asked me ___ I was tired.

questions.def: Indirect questions follow statement word order, not question word order.
questions.question: Can you tell me where ___ the bathroom?

questions.def: 'If' introduces a yes/no indirect question.
questions.question: I wonder ___ she will come to the party.

questions.def: We use the base form of the verb 'know' after 'do'.
questions.question: Do you ___ where the post office is?

questions.def: 'Whether' introduces a yes/no indirect question.
questions.question: I'm not sure ___ I locked the door.

questions.def: 'If' introduces a yes/no indirect question.
questions.question: Can you ask him ___ he needs help?

questions.def: We use 'tell' with an object (me) when asking someone's name.
questions.question: Could you ___ me what your name is?

questions.def: 'Where' asks about a place in an indirect question.
questions.question: I don't remember ___ he lives.
